 FEROZ AHMED KHAN S/O SHRI AHMED KHAN, AGED  ABOUT 38 YEARS, OCCUPATION: BUSINESS R/O FLAT  NO 005 BUILDING NO X-1 GEETA NAGAR PHASE- 4  MEERA ROAD THANE MUMBAI (MAHARASHTRA)
 
 (BY SHRI AMITABH GUPTA - ADVOCATE )
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  S TA T I O N CRIME BRANCH DISTRICT BHOPAL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ADITYA GUPTA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE )

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.

This is first bail application u/S.439 of the Cr.P.C.
filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 12/08/2023 by Police Station- Crime Branch, Bhopal District Bhopal in connection with Crime No.82/2023, registered in relation to the offence punishable under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) and 201 of IPC and Sections 66-D and 66 of the Information 2 MCRC-922-2024 Act, 2008.

Allegation against the present applicant is that he alongwith one other accused (foreigner) used to prepare forged clone of different ATMs and on that basis, they withdrew amounts from the account Feroz Ahmed Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159256495/
1 of different persons.

sentences.text: On the basis of the aforesaid, crime has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
The applicant is not having any criminal antecedents and as such there is no possibility of his fleeing from justice.
He is in custody since 12/08/2023.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
He is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made out.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the application contending that on the basis of the allegations and material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out and prays for rejection of bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the trial is not likely to conclude in near future and prolonged pre- trial detention being an anathema to the concept of liberty, this Court is inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two local sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
3 MCRC-922-2024 1.
The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
